Switching.destination_address_based_forwarding: Destination address field determines forwarding port(s) via configuration table
Switching.frame_discard_on_buffer_congestion: Frames must be discarded when output port has buffer congestion
Switching.maximum_frame_delay_enforcement: Frames exceeding max delay parameter must not be transmitted
Switching.traffic_class_prioritization: Two traffic classes: High Priority and Low Priority
Switching.minimum_inter_frame_gap_enforcement: Minimum Inter-Frame Gap must be maintained when frames are present

Switching.virtual_link_based_switching: Switches must use Virtual Link identifiers for forwarding

traffic_policing_introduction.value: Switches shall police incoming traffic to ensure it complies with configured bandwidth and frame size limits.

jitter_due_to_frame_contention_in_switch.test_hint: Fuzzer could generate frames of unequal or oversized lengths to violate the equal size assumption and observe if the switch correctly calculates or enforces jitter limits.

first_frame_latency_through_switch.test_hint: Fuzzer could manipulate frame size (M) or bandwidth (Nbw) to violate the latency formula and observe if the switch enforces or logs latency deviations.

delayed_frame_latency_through_switch.test_hint: Fuzzer could inject frames with artificially high jitter (Tj) to violate the delayed frame latency formula and observe network behavior.
delayed_frame_latency_through_switch.source_quote: Latency for the delayed frame: Lb = La + Tj

total_switch_latency_definition.test_hint: Fuzzer could simulate excessive output buffer latency to violate the total switch latency constraint and observe if the switch enforces or logs the violation.
total_switch_latency_definition.source_quote: Tw being the total latency in the switch, in seconds (Tsw + output buffer latency)

static_switch_forwarding_based_on_mac_de.value: Switch forwarding must be statically defined based on the MAC destination field of received frames, mapping input ports to output ports.

frame_discard_on_link_failure.value: Frames held in buffers for a failed port must be discarded.
frame_discard_on_link_failure.test_hint: Fuzzer could simulate a link failure and verify if the switch discards frames queued for the failed port.
frame_discard_on_link_failure.source_quote: In the case of a link failure of a port, frames forwarded to and held in buffers of this port should be discarded for this port.

high_priority_frame_precedence.value: High priority frames must be sent before low priority frames on the same output port.
high_priority_frame_precedence.test_hint: Fuzzer could send interleaved high and low priority frames and verify if the switch transmits high priority frames first.
high_priority_frame_precedence.source_quote: For each output port, frames with a priority set to high should be sent prior to the one set to low.

non_preemption_of_low_priority_frames.value: A low priority frame in the process of being transmitted must not be pre-empted by a high priority frame.
non_preemption_of_low_priority_frames.test_hint: Fuzzer could send a low priority frame followed by a high priority frame during transmission and verify if the switch completes the low priority frame before transmitting the high priority one.
non_preemption_of_low_priority_frames.source_quote: A low priority frame in the process of being transmitted should not be pre-empted by the arrival of a high priority frame.

frame_sequencing_in_switch.test_hint: Send frames simultaneously from different sources and verify that the switch sequences them correctly with the expected jitter.

flexible_bandwidth_usage_for_virtual_lin.value: A VL may use less bandwidth by increasing the frame interval or reducing frame size at any time.

flexible_bandwidth_usage_for_virtual_lin.source_quote: The VL may use less bandwidth through an increased frame interval or smaller frames at any time.

bag_enforcement.test_hint: Fuzzer could transmit multiple frames within a single BAG interval to test BAG enforcement.

jitter_definition.test_hint: Fuzzer could introduce jitter values outside the allowed range (e.g., 0 ms, equal to or exceeding BAG) to test jitter bounds.

maximum_usable_bandwidth.test_hint: Fuzzer could generate traffic exceeding the calculated maximum bandwidth (Lmax/BAG) to test bandwidth enforcement.
maximum_usable_bandwidth.source_quote: The maximum usable bandwidth of each VL is characterised by its BAG and its authorized Lmax (maximum VL frame size). The maximum usable bandwidth = Lmax / BAG in Kbytes per seconds.

maximum_latency_calculation.source_quote: This results in a calculable maximum latency in the network, rather than a probabilistic latency.

Traffic Policing.shared_vl_jitter_maximum_selection: Use maximum jitter value of all VLs in shared account group
Traffic Policing.frame_discard_for_non_compliance: Non-compliant frames must be discarded and MIB entries updated

frame_based_traffic_policing.value: Frame-based policing filters VL traffic based on bandwidth usage expressed in frames per second
frame_based_traffic_policing.test_hint: Fuzzer can violate this by exceeding the frame rate limit (frames per second) for a VL configured with frame-based policing.
frame_based_traffic_policing.source_quote: The frame-based traffic policing filters out the VL in terms of bandwidth usage expressed in frames per second

use_vl_identifier_to_access_filtering_an.value: must be used to obtain filtering and policing parameters from the configuration table
use_vl_identifier_to_access_filtering_an.test_hint: Fuzzer can generate frames with a VL ID not present in the configuration table and verify policing behavior.
use_vl_identifier_to_access_filtering_an.source_quote: The switch should use the VL identifier to obtain the appropriate information of filtering and policing from the configuration table.

support_one_to_one_or_one_to_many_mac_de: one ACi for one MAC destination address (VLi)
one ACi for a group of MAC destination addresses (VLs)

shared_vl_must_belong_to_only_one_accoun.value: must be part of one and only one account
shared_vl_must_belong_to_only_one_accoun.test_hint: Fuzzer can generate frames with a VL ID configured to belong to multiple accounts and verify policing behavior.
shared_vl_must_belong_to_only_one_accoun.source_quote: A shared VL will be part of one and only one account.

one_bag,_jitter,_and_maximum_size_value_.value: one BAG value per VL, one jitter value per VL, and one maximum size value per VL
one_bag,_jitter,_and_maximum_size_value_.test_hint: Fuzzer can generate frames with inconsistent BAG, jitter, or size values for the same VL and verify policing behavior.
one_bag,_jitter,_and_maximum_size_value_.source_quote: There should be one BAG value per VL, one jitter value per VL, and one maximum size value per VL.

application_data_encapsulation.value: Application data must be encapsulated inside a UDP datagram or a TCP segment for transmission.
application_data_encapsulation.test_hint: Attempt to send application data without encapsulating it in a UDP datagram or TCP segment.
application_data_encapsulation.source_quote: Application data are transmitted by encapsulation inside an UDP datagram or a TCP segment.

message_encapsulation.value: A message must be encapsulated inside an IP datagram for end-to-end transmission through the AFDX.
message_encapsulation.test_hint: Attempt to send a message without encapsulating it in an IP datagram.
message_encapsulation.source_quote: To be transmitted end-to-end through the AFDX, a message must be encapsulated inside an IP datagram.

ip_datagram_fragmentation.value: If a UDP datagram is too long to fit in a packet, it must be broken into fragments.
ip_datagram_fragmentation.test_hint: Send a UDP datagram that exceeds the MTU without fragmenting it.
ip_datagram_fragmentation.source_quote: Whenever an UDP datagram is too long to fit in a packet, it is break in an almost arbitrary number of pieces that are placed in fragments.

ip_datagram_structure.value: An IP datagram must consist of an IP header followed by transport layer data.
ip_datagram_structure.test_hint: Construct an IP datagram without an IP header or without transport layer data.
ip_datagram_structure.source_quote: An IP datagram consists of an IP header followed by transport layer data, i.e., of an IP header followed by an UDP datagram or a segment.

frame_structure.value: A frame must consist of a MAC header followed by a packet.
frame_structure.test_hint: Send a frame without a MAC header or without a packet.
frame_structure.source_quote: A frame is the unit of transmission at Ethernet level, and consists of a MAC header followed by a packet.

single_frame_maximum_latency_constraint.test_hint: Generate frames that arrive with latency exceeding BAG + Max_jitter + Technological_Latency_in_transmission
single_frame_maximum_latency_constraint.source_quote: the total allowed latency for a given VLi is: MAX_Latency i ≤ BAG i + Max_jitter + Technological_Latency_in_transmission

UDP Checksum Handling.udp_checksum_validation_for_invalid_chec: UDP MUST silently discard datagrams with non-zero and invalid checksums

Virtual Link Source Uniqueness.single_source_end_system_per_virtual_lin: Only one End System within the Avionics network should be the source of any one VL.

Virtual Link Bandwidth.dedicated_maximum_bandwidth_allocation: Each Virtual Link has a dedicated maximum bandwidth allocated by the System Integrator.

Virtual Link Bandwidth Isolation.logical_bandwidth_isolation_between_virt: The ES should provide logical isolation with respect to available bandwidth among the Virtual Link(s) it supports.

reject_invalid_ip_address_on_open.value: MUST reject as an error a local OPEN call for an invalid remote IP address.
reject_invalid_ip_address_on_open.test_hint: Attempt to open a TCP connection to an invalid IP address and check for rejection.
reject_invalid_ip_address_on_open.source_quote: A TCP implementation MUST reject as an error a local OPEN call for an invalid remote IP address.

discard_syn_to_broadcast/multicast.value: MUST silently discard an incoming SYN segment addressed to a broadcast or multicast address.
discard_syn_to_broadcast/multicast.test_hint: Send a SYN segment to a broadcast or multicast address and verify it is discarded.
discard_syn_to_broadcast/multicast.source_quote: A TCP implementation MUST silently discard an incoming SYN segment that is addressed to a broadcast or multicast address.

invalid_source_address_rejection.test_hint: Send frames with invalid source addresses (0.0.0.0, loopback, broadcast, multicast addresses) and verify they are rejected
invalid_source_address_rejection.source_quote: a datagram whose source address does not define a single host -- e.g., a zero address, a loopback address, a broadcast address, a multicast address, or a Class address.

static_addressing_for_intra_afdx.value: For Intra-AFDX communication, the addressing for each message is statically defined.
static_addressing_for_intra_afdx.test_hint: A fuzzer could attempt to send frames with dynamic or incorrect addressing to test if the network enforces static addressing.
static_addressing_for_intra_afdx.source_quote: The principal characteristic of Intra-AFDX communication is the fact that for each message, the addressing is statically defined.

bi_directional_communication_ports.value: Bi-directional communication at a single ES requires two AFDX communication ports: one transmitter and one receiver.
bi_directional_communication_ports.test_hint: A fuzzer could attempt to use a single port for bi-directional communication to test if the network enforces the requirement for separate transmitter and receiver ports.
bi_directional_communication_ports.source_quote: Bi-directional communication, at a single ES should require two AFDX communication ports: one transmitter and one receiver.

rx_buffer_overflow_handling.value: send error message to partition and discard frame on overflow
rx_buffer_overflow_handling.test_hint: Fill receive buffers to capacity and verify overflow frames are discarded with error indication
rx_buffer_overflow_handling.source_quote: If a buffer overflow occurs in reception, an error message should be sent to the receiving partition and the frame should be discarded.

broadcast_address_not_allowed_as_source.value: broadcast addresses must not be used as source address
broadcast_address_not_allowed_as_source.test_hint: Send IP datagrams with broadcast addresses (limited broadcast, directed broadcast, etc.) as the source address to verify they are rejected
broadcast_address_not_allowed_as_source.source_quote: Broadcast address as IP source address

sap_port_bidirectional_communication_req.test_hint: Test bidirectional communication with single SAP to verify it fails or behaves incorrectly compared to using two SAPs
sap_port_bidirectional_communication_req.source_quote: To obtain a bi-directional communication, two SAPs should be used (e.g.: SAP 30 000 Tx and SAP 30 000 Rx).

afdx_port_bidirectional_communication_re.value: Bi-directional communication, at a single ES should require two AFDX communication ports : one transmitter and one receiver
afdx_port_bidirectional_communication_re.test_hint: Test bidirectional communication with single AFDX port to verify it fails or behaves incorrectly compared to using separate transmitter and receiver ports
afdx_port_bidirectional_communication_re.source_quote: Bi-directional communication, at a single ES should require two AFDX communication ports : one transmitter and one receiver, (e.g.: AFDX Com port 15 000 Tx and AFDX Com port 15 000 Rx).

sap_port_transmission_binding_uniqueness.source_quote: In transmission, a SAP Port should only be linked to a single set (UDP port source, IP source and VL (MAC destination)).

sap_port_reception_binding_uniqueness.value: SAP Port must only be linked to a single set of (UDP/TCP port destination, IP destination, VL MAC destination)
sap_port_reception_binding_uniqueness.test_hint: Create multiple reception bindings for the same SAP port with different UDP/TCP destination ports, IP destinations, or VL destinations
sap_port_reception_binding_uniqueness.source_quote: In reception, a SAP Port should only be linked to a single set (UDP/TCP port destination, IP destination and VL (MAC destination))

default_configuration_table.test_hint: Alter the default configuration table and observe if the switch defaults to incorrect behavior.
default_configuration_table.source_quote: The Default_Configuration_Table is used to define the default behavior of the End System of the Switch: default reception and default transmission.

reserved_word_alignment.source_quote: The Reserved word at the beginning of the message should be aligned on a 32-bit boundary.

functional_status_sets_alignment.value: Functional Status Sets should be aligned on 32-bit boundaries.
functional_status_sets_alignment.test_hint: Send frames with misaligned Functional Status Sets to test if the network identifies and handles alignment issues.
functional_status_sets_alignment.source_quote: Functional Status Sets should also be aligned on 32-bit boundaries throughout the message.

double_precision_float_address_alignment.test_hint: Generate frames with double precision float fields at addresses not divisible by 8 bytes

end_system_invariant_parameters_for_perf: Size of IP multicast group per VL

ethernet_frame_compliance.value: Frames must comply with IEEE 802.3 standard
ethernet_frame_compliance.test_hint: Generate frames that do not comply with IEEE 802.3 to test compliance enforcement.
ethernet_frame_compliance.source_quote: Any Ethernet Frame generated by the End System should be compliant with IEEE 802.3 standard.

global_spare_field_must_be_zero_filled.source_quote: If this field is included in a message, it should be filled with all binary zeros.

no_shifting_of_data_set_positions.value: Modifications to a message must not shift the position of existing data sets within the message.

fragment_transmission_order.test_hint: Send a fragmented message and verify fragments are transmitted to the network in the correct order

complete_reassembly_requirement.test_hint: Send fragmented packets and verify partial data is not delivered before all fragments arrive

packet_size_limited_by_mtu.value: packet size must not exceed network MTU, oversized datagrams must be fragmented
packet_size_limited_by_mtu.test_hint: Send packets larger than the configured MTU to test fragmentation handling or rejection

maximum_afdx_frame_length.test_hint: Send frames exceeding the maximum length defined for a VL to test enforcement.
maximum_afdx_frame_length.source_quote: A maximum AFDX frame length should be defined on a per VL basis.

unique_message_identification.value: Each message in the AFDX network is uniquely identified by a quintuplet consisting of UDP Source Port, Source IP, Destination MAC, Destination IP, and UDP Destination Port.

unique_message_identification.source_quote: In the AFDX network, this quintuplet provides a unique identification for each message.

frame_check_sequence_validity.value: FCS embedded in the frame must match the calculation upon reception
frame_check_sequence_validity.test_hint: Send frames with incorrect FCS to test if they are discarded.
frame_check_sequence_validity.source_quote: The frame integrity: whether the FCS embedded in the frame matches the calculation upon reception

pin_programming_read_condition.source_quote: Hardware program pins should be read during the initialization (INIT mode) of the SWITCH only if the Switch_Ground_Condition is true and before performing the Safety Test (if any).

pin_programming_flight_behavior.value: When Switch_Ground_Condition is false, hardware program pins should not be read and switch should use last memorized values
pin_programming_flight_behavior.test_hint: Verify switch ignores pin programming changes when Switch_Ground_Condition is false
pin_programming_flight_behavior.source_quote: When the Switch_Ground_Condition is false, hardware program pins should not be read. The Switch should use the last memorized values.

pin_programming_parity_check.value: The 12 program pins (P1 to P12) should be checked by a parity bit
pin_programming_parity_check.test_hint: Send pin programming with invalid parity and verify switch rejects it
pin_programming_parity_check.source_quote: The 12 program pins (P1 to P12) should be checked by a parity bit.

minimum_output_port_buffer_capacity.test_hint: Send more than 512 frames to a single output port simultaneously and verify the switch can buffer them without dropping frames
minimum_output_port_buffer_capacity.source_quote: Each output port of the switch should be able to buffer at least 512 frames (balanced between high and low priority).

buffer_allocation_balance_between_priori.value: balanced between high and low priority
buffer_allocation_balance_between_priori.test_hint: Send mix of high and low priority frames exceeding buffer capacity and verify both priority levels get fair buffer allocation
buffer_allocation_balance_between_priori.source_quote: Each output port of the switch should be able to buffer at least 512 frames (balanced between high and low priority).

traffic_policing_function_requirement.value: switches must implement traffic policing function
traffic_policing_function_requirement.test_hint: Send traffic that exceeds policing parameters and verify it is dropped or rate-limited by the switch

policing_and_filtering_parameters_requir.value: switches must implement policing and filtering parameters
policing_and_filtering_parameters_requir.test_hint: Configure invalid or missing policing/filtering parameters and verify switch behavior

jitter_time_formula.test_hint: A fuzzer could send frames of different sizes simultaneously to a switch to test if jitter calculations are correctly applied
jitter_time_formula.source_quote: Tj = (8 x M) / Nbw + Tmin_gap(it is assumed that the frames are of equal size).

first_frame_latency_formula.value: La = Ts + Tm1 + Tsw + (8 x M)/Nbw + Tm2 + Tr
first_frame_latency_formula.test_hint: A fuzzer could measure actual first frame latency and compare against calculated values to verify proper switch behavior
first_frame_latency_formula.source_quote: Latency for the first frame:  La = Ts + Tm1 + Tsw + ( 8 x M )/Nbw + Tm2 + Tr

delayed_frame_latency_formula.test_hint: A fuzzer could send simultaneous frames to test if the second frame experiences the correct additional jitter delay
delayed_frame_latency_formula.source_quote: Latency for the delayed frame:  Lb = La + Tj

switch_latency_traffic_dependency.value: total switch latency (Tw) depends on traffic flow for the specific output port
switch_latency_traffic_dependency.test_hint: A fuzzer could vary traffic loads on different output ports and verify that latency varies accordingly per port
switch_latency_traffic_dependency.source_quote: Tw, referenced to an output port, depends on the traffic flow for that output port

ops_mode_entry_conditions.value: Switch enters OPS mode only if compatibility checks are correct AND shop condition is not active
ops_mode_entry_conditions.test_hint: Simulate switch with failed compatibility checks or active shop condition and verify it does not enter OPS mode
ops_mode_entry_conditions.source_quote: After the initialization sequence, the Switch should enter in OPS (operational mode) if the result of compatibility checks is correct and if the shop condition is not active.

ops_mode_switch_functions.value: In OPS mode, Switch must perform frames filtering, Traffic policing, Switching function, and End System function using OPS_Configuration_File data
ops_mode_switch_functions.test_hint: Verify switch only uses OPS_Configuration_File data and performs all required functions when in OPS mode
ops_mode_switch_functions.source_quote: In OPS, the Switch should perform its normal functions (frames filtering and Traffic policing functions, Switching function, End System function) exclusively relying upon the data contained in the act

dl_mode_entry_from_init_conditions.value: From INIT mode, Switch enters DL mode only if Switch_Ground_Condition is active AND (compatibility checks incorrect OR no loaded software)
dl_mode_entry_from_init_conditions.test_hint: Test switch behavior when ground condition is inactive or when compatibility checks are correct with loaded software

passive_mode_entry_conditions.value: From INIT mode, Switch enters PASSIVE mode if pin programming parity check fails OR safety test result is incorrect
passive_mode_entry_conditions.test_hint: Simulate pin programming parity failures or safety test failures and verify switch enters PASSIVE mode
passive_mode_entry_conditions.source_quote: From the INIT mode, the Switch should enter in PASSIVE Mode as soon as one of the following conditions is true: • Pin programming parity check fails • Safety Test (if any) result is incorrect

passive_mode_switch_function_restriction.value: In PASSIVE mode, Switch functions must be stopped and switch must remain silent, except Network Management Function communication
passive_mode_switch_function_restriction.test_hint: Verify switch does not perform normal switching functions but can still communicate with Network Management Function
passive_mode_switch_function_restriction.source_quote: In PASSIVE Mode, the functions of the Switch should be stopped and the switch should keep silent. Nevertheless, the capability to communicate with the Network Management Function should be maintained

quiet_mode_frame_transmission_restrictio.value: In QUIET mode, switch functions are stopped, switch does not transmit frames, and all ports are disabled
quiet_mode_frame_transmission_restrictio.test_hint: Verify switch completely stops frame transmission and disables all ports when in QUIET mode
quiet_mode_frame_transmission_restrictio.source_quote: In QUIET mode, the functions of the switch are stopped, the switch does not transmit frames or allow communication with the switch management function (SNMP). The switch software disables all ports wh

maximum_vl_processing_capacity.test_hint: Send traffic with more than 4096 different VLs and verify switch can handle them
maximum_vl_processing_capacity.source_quote: The filtering, policing, and forwarding function of the switch should be able to process at least 4096 VLs.

mac_layer_wire_speed_transmission_requir.value: must transmit frames at wire speed
mac_layer_wire_speed_transmission_requir.test_hint: Generate continuous back-to-back frames at maximum rate and verify switch can maintain wire speed transmission without dropping or delaying frames
mac_layer_wire_speed_transmission_requir.source_quote: The MAC layer of each switch output port should be able to transmit frames at wire speed.

switch_technological_latency_limit.test_hint: Measure time between reception of last bit of input frame and transmission of last bit of output frame, verify it stays under 100 μs
switch_technological_latency_limit.source_quote: The technological latency of the switch should be less than 100 μs.

filter_wire_speed_capability.value: Each switch port should filter frames of any valid size arriving at wire speed
filter_wire_speed_capability.test_hint: Send frames of varying sizes at wire speed and verify filtering operates correctly
filter_wire_speed_capability.source_quote: Each switch port should be able to filter frames of any valid size that are arriving at wire speed.

relay_wire_speed_capability.value: Given deterministic configuration, switch should relay all non-rejected incoming frames at wire speed whatever their size
relay_wire_speed_capability.test_hint: Send frames that pass filtering and policing at wire speed and verify relay operates without delays
relay_wire_speed_capability.source_quote: Given a deterministic configuration, the switch should be able to relay all incoming frames that are not rejected by filtering and policing, at wire speed and whatever their size.

maximum_frame_delay_enforcement.test_hint: Delay frames in switch buffers beyond configured max_delay parameter and verify they are discarded
maximum_frame_delay_enforcement.source_quote: An output port should not transmit frames that are older than "max delay." The "max delay" parameter is defined on a per port basis in the configuration table.

bandwidth_limitation_per_virtual_link.value: Transmission of frames on a Virtual Link must be delayed according to the BAG_i to comply with bandwidth limitations.
bandwidth_limitation_per_virtual_link.test_hint: Fuzzer can generate frames violating BAG_i by sending them faster than the allowed interval.
bandwidth_limitation_per_virtual_link.source_quote: The transmission will be delayed according to the bandwidth limitation of the VL (traffic shaping).

bag_frame_rate_limiting.test_hint: Send multiple frames within a single BAG interval on the same VL
bag_frame_rate_limiting.source_quote: On a per VL basis the traffic regulator (traffic shaping function) should shape the flow to send no more than one frame in each interval of BAG milliseconds

exact_bandwidth_regulated_traffic_contro.test_hint: Generate frame arrivals that violate bounded arrival distribution patterns, such as burst traffic exceeding bandwidth limits
exact_bandwidth_regulated_traffic_contro.source_quote: frame delivery follows a bounded arrival distribution. This bounded arrival implies exact bandwidth regulated traffic control.

ethernet_frame_size_must_meet_virtual_li.test_hint: When byte-based policing is enabled, send frames smaller than Smin for the Virtual Link
ethernet_frame_size_must_meet_virtual_li.source_quote: Ethernet frame size (S) greater than or equal to Smin, only in case where byte-based traffic policing is used

ac_account_crediting_rate_limit.source_quote: ACi is credited as time elapses, proportionally to S i max with an upper limit of BAG i

budget_consumption_exclusion_for_invalid.test_hint: Send invalid frames that get discarded and verify budget accounts are not debited
budget_consumption_exclusion_for_invalid.source_quote: Budget Accounts (Bytes ACi and Frame ACi) should not be consumed by invalid frames, i.e. frames not forwarded by the forwarding function. No budget should be consumed by frames that are discarded by t

high_priority_frame_transmission_precede.test_hint: Queue low priority frames then send high priority frames to verify scheduling order
high_priority_frame_transmission_precede.source_quote: For each output port, frames with a priority set to high should be sent prior to the one set to low.

virtual_link_as_unidirectional_logical_c.value: A Virtual Link (VL) is a unidirectional logical communication path from one source End System to one or more destination End Systems. It defines a multicast flow of AFDX frames.
virtual_link_as_unidirectional_logical_c.test_hint: Fuzzer could violate this by sending frames from multiple source End Systems on the same VL or by sending bidirectional traffic on a VL.
virtual_link_as_unidirectional_logical_c.source_quote: Virtual Link: A Virtual Link (VL) is a unidirectional logical communication path from one source End System to one or more destination End Systems.

unidirectional_connection.value: A Virtual Link defines a logical unidirectional connection from one source end-system to one or more destination end-systems.
unidirectional_connection.test_hint: Fuzzer could generate a VL with bidirectional traffic or multiple source end-systems to violate unidirectionality.
unidirectional_connection.source_quote: A Virtual Link defines a logical unidirectional connection from one source end-system to one or more destination end-systems, shown in Figure 3-2.

ordinal_integrity.value: For each Virtual Link, the End System should maintain the ordering of data as delivered by a partition, for both transmission and reception.
ordinal_integrity.test_hint: Fuzzer could reorder frames within a VL to test if ordinal integrity is enforced.
ordinal_integrity.source_quote: For each Virtual Link, the End System should maintain the ordering of data as delivered by a partition, for both transmission and reception (ordinal integrity).

source_partition_exclusivity.value: One Virtual Link should not be shared by two or more source partitions.
source_partition_exclusivity.test_hint: Fuzzer could simulate multiple partitions transmitting on the same VL to test exclusivity.
source_partition_exclusivity.source_quote: One Virtual Link should not be shared by two or more source partitions.

jitter_definition_for_virtual_link.value: Ji,switch represents the maximum jitter (window) within which a frame for VLi is assured to be located when entering a switch (expressed in seconds)
jitter_definition_for_virtual_link.test_hint: Fuzzer can violate this by introducing jitter exceeding Ji,switch for a given VL.
jitter_definition_for_virtual_link.source_quote: The Jitter (representing the Window a frame is assured to be located within) associated to VLi entering a particular switch is Ji,switch (expressed in seconds)

default_reception_vl_identifier_format.value: VL (0, position), where '0' indicates reception VL and 'position' depends on the switch's location in the aircraft network.
default_reception_vl_identifier_format.test_hint: Fuzzer could generate frames with malformed VL identifiers (e.g., VL (2, position), VL (0, invalid)) and observe if the switch rejects or processes them incorrectly.
default_reception_vl_identifier_format.source_quote: Depending of its position in the aircraft network, acquired by pin programming, the Switch subscribes by default to one unique reception VL, further called VL (0, position). '0' indicates that it is a

default_reception_vl_non_volatile_config.value: Must include VL identifier (MAC destination address), maximum allowed Total Ethernet Line size (smax), and Bandwidth Allocation Gap (BAG) in non-volatile memory.
default_reception_vl_non_volatile_config.test_hint: Fuzzer could generate frames with missing or corrupted default reception VL configuration parameters and observe if the switch fails to process them.
default_reception_vl_non_volatile_config.source_quote: The reception part of the Default_Configuration_Table of the Switch should contain at least, in nonvolatile memory, the following information (characteristics of the default reception VL): VL identifi

virtual_link_bandwidth_and_frame_interva.test_hint: Violate VL bandwidth bounds or send frames outside the defined frame delivery interval
virtual_link_bandwidth_and_frame_interva.source_quote: This is achieved by bounding both the bandwidth and the frame delivery interval for each VL.

single_source_per_vl_constraint.test_hint: Generate frames with the same VL ID but from multiple different source end systems
single_source_per_vl_constraint.source_quote: Only one End System within the Avionics network should be the source of any one VL.

switch_subscribes_to_unique_default_rece.value: Each switch subscribes to exactly one unique reception VL based on position
switch_subscribes_to_unique_default_rece.test_hint: Test switch behavior when configured with multiple default reception VLs or no default reception VL
switch_subscribes_to_unique_default_rece.source_quote: Depending of its position in the aircraft network, acquired by pin programming, the Switch subscribes by default to one unique reception VL, further called VL (0, position).

switch_has_unique_default_transmission_v.value: Each switch has exactly one unique transmission VL based on position
switch_has_unique_default_transmission_v.test_hint: Test switch behavior when configured with multiple default transmission VLs
switch_has_unique_default_transmission_v.source_quote: Each Switch has a unique default transmission VL, further called VL (1, position).

maximum_allowed_total_ethernet_line_size.test_hint: Send frames on a VL that exceed the configured Smax value to test policing function
maximum_allowed_total_ethernet_line_size.source_quote: Maximum allowed Total Ethernet Line size (Smax)

minimum_allowed_total_ethernet_line_size.test_hint: Send frames on a VL that are smaller than the configured Smin value to test policing function
minimum_allowed_total_ethernet_line_size.source_quote: Minimum allowed Total Ethernet Line size (Smin)
